evidence.current_state: Most rows are NEUTRAL flat with reddit mentions 0 and reddit signal NO_DATA.
evidence.frontend_behavior: Clicking a pulse card calls selectTicker and writes a TICKER command into Bob's input box.

risks: The panel label LIVE can be misleading because it means the UI endpoint is refreshing, not that every provider has strong fresh data.
RedditPulse currently returns zero mentions for the displayed tickers, so the social side is weak.
NO_DATA is displayed for the Reddit signal even when institutional/news sources exist.
The command is prepared in Bob's input box but the current architecture still needs CASE enforcement so Bob cannot ignore tools.
next_step: If fixing next, improve Sentimento Vivo semantics: separate provider health from signal quality, show news article counts clearly, and make clicks open a CASE ticker analysis automatically instead of only drafting text.
